Theme 047 · Metaphor concepts

The Safety Net

A flat, elegant big top. Faceless geometric trapeze artists pass metric chips between swings in time with the music; below them hangs an almost invisible net woven from thin data lines. One chip slips, the net catches it, and the ringmaster, a human, decides what happens next.

readability ●●●trust ●●○effort high
1 · HOOK0:00–0:08

Two artists swing in counter-phase, passing more and more chips across the gap, one per beat. On the last downbeat the coral Checkout chip tilts and starts to fall toward an empty ring: no net.

2 · REVEAL0:08 (drop)

On the drop the net unrolls from the centre knot outward to both poles (0.5 s, expo.out) under a fresh spotlight. The teal banner drops in from above with a small elastic bounce, "Acme Pulse" across it.

3 · PROOF MOMENT0:12–0:32

Mid-pass the Checkout chip slips and falls straight down; the net sags and snaps back with elastic.out while a ripple spreads across the mesh. The caught knot lights coral on the downbeat, the callout draws out, and the ringmaster taps "Roll back" to toss the chip back up.

4 · CTA0:36–0:45

The corrected chip arcs back up into the spotlight (motion path, spinning) and lands in the catcher's hands on beat 1. "You ship." on beat 1, "Pulse watches." on beat 3; the net glows once under the button on the final downbeat.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Big-top stripes — flat radiating tent panels in two inks; the stage.
  • Trapeze artists — faceless geometric silhouettes on pendulum bars; the team doing the work.
  • Metric chips — rounded tokens with mono labels, teal when fine, coral when slipping.
  • Data-line net — thin teal mesh with knots; the agent, invisible until needed.
  • Catch ripple + callout — rings spread from the caught knot; the callout carries the anomaly.
  • Ringmaster card — the human decision (Roll back / Acknowledge).

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Pendulum — bar rotation ±22°, sine.inOut, one full swing per two bars at 120 BPM (4 s); passes happen on the "and" of beat 4.
  • Net catch — mesh vertices sag 40 px then recover with elastic.out(1, 0.35) over 0.9 s; the ripple ring expands over one beat.
  • Rebound toss — the corrected chip rides an arcing motion path in 0.8 s with one full spin, landing on a downbeat.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

A safety net is the most intuitive picture of "you can move fast because something catches you", and it keeps the humans as the performers. Risk: it can imply the team keeps dropping things; frame the slip as the world changing mid-air (a deploy), not as human failure.

Adapt to your product: Name the chips after what your team juggles (invoices, releases, tickets) and label the net's knots with the rules your product checks.
